propositions: Core outbound_links.py imports adapters.jira directly to compare links in vendor shape, violating vendor-opaque boundary principle (ADR 0035 §(d)) and epic bbf1 AC3 requirement for zero adapters.jira imports in core.

Link translation logic is split between core (_existing_jira_links dedup, inline _diff_links relation translation) and adapter (_RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK map), making vendor link-type handling non-canonical and opaque.

The SupportsLinks capability must expose map_remote_links() to consume vendor issuelinks and emit canonical (relation, remote_key, opaque_vendor_type) tuples, and link_payload_for_relation() to emit (vendor_type, swap) for ADD/REMOVE payloads, so core compares only canonical relations.

Direction-agnostic dedup behavior (matching a local dep against a remote link regardless of inward/outward side) must be preserved by dedup matching on (opaque_vendor_type, remote_key) pairs, not (relation, remote_key), while managed-gate REMOVE matching uses relation-specific logic.
The AST neutrality gate must extend to assert zero adapters.jira imports in outbound_links.py and outbound_differ.py after refactoring.
